The first rule doesn't keep its own list of reads. It gets them from the `TOPICS` block in `apps/desktop/src/renderer/lib/query/catalogue.ts`, and the script throws an error if it can't find that block. The last rule (`sync/actor-write-records-directory`) works differently from the rest: instead of banning a pattern, it fails when a write to `actors` appears in a file with no matching `recordActor()` call.
